answer_1.quote: We evaluate our approach on {ZH, FR}→EN document-level translation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: English translations of source documents (sentence and document level)

answer_2.quote: We report both sentence-level metric (s-BLEU) and document-level metric (d-BLEU) to evaluate the quality of the translation. ... we also report the LTCR (Lexical Translation Consistency Ratio) score.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 500 sentences from the test set and conduct a human evaluation on them. For each selected source-side sentence, we assign its translation background and corresponding two generated translations ... to two human annotators without order.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare the two translations and indicate whether they are equal, the proposed system is better, or the baseline is better.
